variables_and_units: latency, throughput, target rate and raw iPerf logs
independent_units: location and complete run, invalid clocks retained
validation_design: location and complete run, invalid clocks retained Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.
author_preprocessing: All 245 raw runs and source processed tables/code. Three invalid one-way-delay runs are retained and flagged; processed tables replace them with cell means.
prior_analysis_and_limits: Hold out locations or whole runs. Fit against achieved throughput, not only target rate. Raw and imputed versions must not be mixed without disclosure.
missingness: Native blanks, sentinels, absent records and source quality flags are preserved. No imputation performed by the curator. Exact missingness semantics come from source dictionaries/headers; no universal missing-value rule is imposed.
calibration: Use the retained source calibration files/standards and instrument metadata where provided. Absence of an explicit calibration record is not replaced by an assumed calibration.
